newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia police seize fake Louis Vuitton items.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia police seize fake Louis Vuitton items.

text.p: Indonesian police confiscated 250 counterfeit items bearing the logo of French luxury travel goods maker Louis Vuitton in raids earlier this month, lawyers for the company said on Thursday.
The lawyers said fake handbags, travelbags, luggage and wallets were seized from 22 counters in five shopping centres in the capital Jakarta during the June 18-25 raids.

"Some of the outlets managed to confuse consumers into believing that the counterfeits are genuine Louis Vuitton products by pricing the fake products a little bit less than the price of the genuine items," the lawyers said in a statement.
It said police had questioned the retailers.

"Louis Vuitton is very committed to put a stop to all infringement activities in Indonesia. There are plans to pursue other tougher measures and to organise more frequent raids in the near future," it said.
Under Indonesia's law on trademarks, conterfeiting carries a maximum penalty of seven years in jail and a fine of 100 million rupiah.
